title: Act Apprentice (various trades)
qualification: The minimum requirement of 50% aggregate marks in Matriculation is not applicable to candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD categories. Only completing the ITI course is not sufficient - candidates must be in possession of their ITI pass certificate/NTC/STC as on the date of the notification (14-07-2026).
salary: Minimum stipend for NTC/STC holders:₹9,600 per month, effective from 11-09-2025, as per G.S.R. 610(E) dated 03-09-2025 issued by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (RBE No. 116/2025). || Where one or two years' exemption is admissible under the Apprenticeship curriculum:₹10,560/month(2nd year, 10% increase) and₹11,040/month(3rd year, 15% increase). || Stipend rates are subject to revision from time to time as notified by the appropriate authority. || No hostel accommodation is provided; apprentices must make their own arrangements during training.
age_limit: Candidates must be not below 15 years and not above 24 years of age as on the closing date of application, i.e., 19-08-2026. || For children of ex-servicemen, the same age relaxation as applicable to their respective community (UR/SC/ST/OBC) will apply.
application_fee: Candidates seeking fee exemption as Economically Backward Class (EBC) must have family income of less than ₹50,000/- per annum and must upload a certificate issued on or after 01-04-2026 (Annexure-XVI). If a candidate wishes to modify or correct the online application after submission, a fee of ₹50/- is charged for each occasion; however, registration details cannot be modified.
selection_process: Selection is purely merit-based, with no written examination. The merit list for each unit is prepared using thepercentage of marks in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) plus ITI marksin the relevant trade; the final panel is based on the average of the two. || For Medical Laboratory Technician (Pathology) and (Radiology), merit is based on Matriculation marks plus 12th Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) marks. || Calculation uses marks obtained inall subjectsof Matriculation/12th, not select subjects, and the average ITI marks across all semesters (or the National Trade Certificate marks). || Merit lists are prepared unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, in descending order of percentage, equal to the number of notified slots. || Shortlisted candidates are called forDocument Verification (DV)to the extent of 1.5 times the notified vacancies. || A candidate is considered for only one combination of Unit-Department-Trade based on merit and order of preference; once selected against a higher preference, all lower preferences are automatically cancelled. || In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate (by age) is ranked higher; if date of birth is also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier is ranked higher.

title: Young Professional (4 post codes)
qualification: Key eligibility notes as per the notification: || Candidates must possess the required mark sheets/certificates confirming eligibility as on 22.07.2026 (the last date of application). || Experience will be counted only in the fields specified for each post; no other experience will be considered. || The experience certificate must clearly state the field of experience; only post-qualification experience is counted. || For Post Code 02 (PCS Marketing), desirable skills include good communication and interpersonal skills, basic knowledge of pest control techniques and services, proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), analytical and reporting skills, and the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
salary: Post Code 01 (Learning & Development):₹50,000/- consolidated per month for 0 to 3 years' experience, OR ₹60,000/- consolidated per month for more than 3 years' experience. || Post Code 02 (PCS Marketing):₹50,000/- consolidated per month for 0 to 3 years' experience, OR ₹60,000/- consolidated per month for more than 3 years' experience. || Post Code 03 (Marketing & Business Development - Hyderabad):₹50,000/- consolidated per month for 0 to 3 years' experience, OR ₹60,000/- consolidated per month for more than 3 years' experience. || Post Code 04 (Marketing & Business Development - Jaipur):Same remuneration structure as Post Code 03, as per the merged entry in the official notification. || The consolidated remuneration is inclusive of all applicable taxes, and no other facility or allowance will be provided in addition to it. || Also Read: Calculate your exact in-hand Salary in 10 seconds - Calculate Now
age_limit: The reckoning date for calculation of both age and experience is the last date of application, i.e., 05.08.2026 .
application_fee: Application fee details were not specified in the official notification shared for this article. Candidates should check the online application portal on www.cewacor.nic.in at the time of applying for any applicable fee.
selection_process: The notification states that CWC reserves the right to fix criteria for shortlisting candidates in order to restrict the number of candidates called for Personal Interaction , based on the number of positions advertised. No written examination or other selection stage is mentioned in the notification.

title: Forest Range Officer (Van Kshetra Padadhikari)
qualification: A candidate must hold at least one of the following: || A Bachelor's degree with at least one subject from: Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science, Botany, Chemistry, Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or Zoology, from a recognized university, OR || A Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Forestry, or Engineering from a recognized university or equivalent institution.
salary: The selected Forest Range Officer will be placed at Pay Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400) as per the 7th Pay Commission matrix. The notification does not specify a separate in-hand or gross salary figure including allowances.
age_limit: Age is calculated based on the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation (10th) or equivalent certificate.
application_fee: Payment must be made online. Candidates using Net Banking, Credit Card, or RuPay Debit Card will bear the applicable bank transaction charges separately. No other mode of payment is accepted. Fee once paid successfully will not be refunded, except in cases where the amount is deducted but registration fails due to technical/bank issues - in such cases, the amount will be refunded by the payment gateway within 7 working days.
selection_process: Selection is made through a Written Examination, Interview, and Physical Efficiency Test.

title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
qualification: M.Tech./B.Tech./M.Sc. (Electrical/Electronics/Communication/Instrumentation/Computer Science & Engineering) with GATE score and minimum CPI of 6.5 or 60% (for M.Tech) or 7.5 or 70% (for B.Tech/M.Sc). B.Tech from IITs with min CPI 7.5 are exempted from GATE. Exceptional candidates with M.Tech and 2 years experience may be offered SRF directly.
age_limit: JRF: Max 32 years for M.Tech, Max 28 years for B.Tech/B.Sc(Engg.)/M.Sc.

title: Associate Professor and Assistant Professor – 95 Posts
qualification: Doctoral degree in the relevant subject, including relevant basic sciences. || 08 years' experience in the relevant subject as Assistant Professor-cum-Junior Scientist/Scientist/Lecturer/Extension Specialist or an equivalent position in Pay Band-3 of Rs. 15,600–39,100 with GP/AGP/RGP of Rs. 5,400/Rs. 6,000/Rs. 7,000/Rs. 8,000, with evidence of contribution to research/teaching/extension education through published work or innovations and impact,OR || Doctoral degree in the relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, with a minimum of 8 years of high-quality post-doctoral research experience in an institution/organization, evidenced by at least 6 publications in journals with a NAAS rating of 7.5 or above. || A basic undergraduate degree in Veterinary Science is part of the essential qualification, as per VCI Regulation 2016.
age_limit: 5 years' extra age relaxation for Govt. of Bihar employees applying for a higher pay scale (Resolution No. 3/M-63/2005-2374 dated 16.07.2007). || No age restriction for existing BASU employees seeking higher posts under direct recruitment procedures. || Divyang (differently-abled) candidates of all categories get an additional 10 years' relaxation in maximum age (Resolution No. 13062 dated 12.10.2017). || Retirement age at BASU is 65 years.
application_fee: The fee is non-refundable and must be paid by Bank Draft in favour of "Finance Comptroller, Bihar Animal Sciences University, Patna", payable at Patna. || Fee relaxation is applicable only to original residents of Bihar, subject to submission of a caste certificate. || Separate application forms and separate fees are required for each post, and separately for Bihar Veterinary College, Patna and College of Veterinary & Animal Science, Kishanganj.
selection_process: Selection is based on the candidate's previous academic and professional record (as per the prescribed scorecard) and performance in the interview. || As per Chapter-VII Note-6(iii) of the University Statute, a candidate must obtain at least 50% marks in the interview to be considered in the merit list. || As per the directive of the Dairy, Fisheries and Animal Resource Department, Govt. of Bihar (L.No. 06/BASU(II)07/2023-4229 dated 13.11.2023), candidates belonging to SC, ST, Divyang category, and female candidates (irrespective of category) need to obtain only 32% marks in the interview to be considered in the merit list. || Candidates must produce all original certificates and documents at the time of interview for verification; failure to do so can lead to rejection of candidature. || The Chairman of the Selection Committee has the authority to decide the procedure for any matter not covered in the notification, and the Committee may decide its own method of evaluating interview performance.

title: Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre)
qualification: Candidates must hold a graduate degree or an equivalent qualification as on 01-08-2025 to be eligible for the Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre) post.
salary: The post of Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre) carries Pay Level-6 as per the notification. The official notification does not mention a specific in-hand salary figure.
age_limit: The age limit is calculated as on the cut-off date of 01-08-2025, based on the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or equivalent certificate. The category-wise age limits are given below. || Additional age relaxation is available for specific categories: || Bihar government servants seeking promotion to a higher pay scale/cadre, with a minimum of 3 years of regular service, are eligible for a 5-year relaxation in the maximum age limit. || Ex-servicemen applying for civil posts get a relaxation of 3 years plus the length of their defence service, provided their actual age does not exceed 57 years as on the cut-off date.
application_fee: The application fee is the same for all category male and female candidates and must be paid online. || Application Fee: Rs. 100/- (for all categories) || Accepted payment modes: Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card and UPI || Bank charges applicable on Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card transactions must be borne by the candidate || Application fee once paid successfully will not be refunded
selection_process: Selection to the post of Police Sub-Inspector (General Closed Cadre) will be made through a three-stage process consisting of a Preliminary Exam, a Main Exam and a Physical Efficiency Test (PET).

qualification: Class XII pass with Skill Certificate in Domestic Data Entry Operator
age_limit: The minimum age for IOCL Barauni Apprentice 2026 is 18 years, and the maximum is 24 years as on 30 June 2026 for General/EWS candidates. Age relaxation is extended to SC, ST, OBC (NCL), and PwBD candidates as per Government of India guidelines — up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and up to 10 years for PwBD candidates irrespective of reservation.
